page_title: HOF 3-1 UNI | Hoffenheim v Union Berlin 31/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' A pass into the box finds Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Frederik Ronnow denies him.
90+4' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is penalised for a foul. Robin Braun had a clear view and blows his whistle.

90+2' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
90+2' The ball goes out for a corner. Union Berlin can continue in their attacking effort.
90+1' It is time for a substitution. Kevin Akpoguma (Hoffenheim) is on for Bazoumana Toure.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) launches himself at a lofted pass, but his close-range header flies just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
87' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing.
86' Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
84' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
84' Robin Braun shows a yellow card to Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) for his blatant foul. Union Berlin win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
83' Steffen Baumgart has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Kral (Union Berlin) replacing Aljoscha Kemlein.
83' Andrej Kramaric will be replaced by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim).
82' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) connects with the resultant free kick but produces a header straight at Frederik Ronnow.
78' Christian Ilzer has decided to make a change. Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) replaces Fisnik Asllani.
76' Union Berlin can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' The attendance for today's match is 19341.
75' The referee signals a substitution. Livan Burcu (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Diogo Leite.
72' The referee blows his whistle as Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) was too aggressive in his challenge.
68' No foul! Referee Robin Braun points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Union Berlin players celebrate.
68' Wait! Referee Robin Braun immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an infringement in the build-up play.
68' 3 - 1 Goal! Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Oliver Baumann. He makes it 3:1.

67' Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.

66' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Robin Braun with no other option than to blow for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Union Berlin.
63' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Robin Braun blows for a foul.
62' Total attempts – 4:8.
60' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but Oliver Baumann pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
58' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.

55' Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
54' Substitution. Oliver Burke will be replaced by Ilyas Ansah (Union Berlin).
54' Here is a change. Stanley Nsoki is going off and Steffen Baumgart gives the last tactical orders to Derrick Kohn (Union Berlin).
54' It's time for a substitution. Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) comes on in place of Woo-Yeong Jeong.
51' The corner is swung in but Hoffenheim can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
49' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul.
47' 3 - 0 Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) puts the ball into the back of the net but, unfortunately for him and his teammates, it's into his own goal!

46' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Christian Ilzer gives a chance to Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) and Tim Lemperle is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' 2 - 0 Goal – 2:0! Bazoumana Toure sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the bottom left corner.
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Frederik Ronnow to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
41' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

39' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robin Braun no option but to blow his whistle. It's a penalty to Hoffenheim! Let's see who's going to take it.
39' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
39' Some great controlled play and passing from Hoffenheim. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
36' Union Berlin failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
35' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
34' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
31' Frederik Ronnow displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
30' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.

28' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
26' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
24' The free kick from long range, taken by Hoffenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

23' Leopold Querfeld (Union Berlin) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Hoffenheim, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
21' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) was quite harsh and Robin Braun didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

20' Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) spurns a big chance! He makes himself some space to meet a cross and from near the penalty spot sends a header well wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
17' None of the Hoffenheim players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
15' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
12' Stanley Nsoki (Union Berlin) makes a rough challenge and Robin Braun blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Union Berlin take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Union Berlin comes to nothing. Union Berlin force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Union Berlin. The ball goes out of play. Union Berlin are awarded a corner kick.
9' Albian Hajdari (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robin Braun had an easy-decision to make.
8' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Oliver Baumann.

6' The corner is slung over and Andrej Ilic (Union Berlin) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
6' Union Berlin will take a corner kick.
4' The foul by Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) was seen by Robin Braun who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
2' The resulting set piece from Hoffenheim is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' The first half has started.
Union Berlin will kick the game off.
Robin Braun will referee today's match.
